summary: Georgia Power Company filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $1.3 billion in senior notes under an existing shelf registration. The offering includes an additional $150 million of 4.85% Series 2025B Notes due 2031, $600 million of floating-rate Series 2026A Notes due 2027, and $550 million of 4.60% Series 2026B Notes due 2029. Underwriters include BMO, Mizuho, MUFG, RBC, and SMBC. The debt was issued under a shelf registration statement and indentures with U.S. Bank Trust. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation event; no change of control or strategic pivot is implied.
